goal: Adds a startup option to disallow plaintext v1 connections to IPv4/IPv6 peers
Protects privacy-conscious users from passive network observers fingerprinting their traffic
reviewability: Stale: needs rebase and mergeable state is dirty
Maintainers postponed to v33 since reviewers disagree on the core listen=0 design
Reviewing now risks being invalidated by a future approach change
agreement: Disputed: broad concept support but the core design choice is actively contested
Nonblocking objection: forcing listen=0 is structurally counterproductive (gmaxwell)
Unaddressed objection: coupling to listen=0 not compelling, no resolution yet (mzumsande)
Concept ACK but prefers an alternative design option B (ViniciusCestarii)
Many concept ACKs without deep design engagement (sipa, kristapsk, laanwj, dergoegge, fjahr, sedited, davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it offers a real privacy-hardening option for operators worried about passive traffic inspection
Value is opt-in and narrow since it doesn't hide that a node runs Bitcoin at all
Not yet P1 since the design is still contested and may substantially change before landing
